name: Nozzletown
summary:
Nozzletown is an idle 3D printing tycoon game in which the player prints a whole town. It starts with one printer on a bedroom desk printing keychains and phone stands for the neighbors; every print grows layer by layer. Printed parts such as walls, roofs, lamp posts and fountains fly to their plots and print again in place, opening buildings like the Stationer, the Bakery, the Park, the Square and the Harbor.

The player fills an order board, queues each printer's jobs, upgrades printers and hires helpers who keep printing while the player is away. A Print Book collects 48 objects, and Retool starts a new town by the sea or in the snow.
